bagua.page.intro:
§lXuanshu Aspects§r
The eight trigrams are the key to the xuanshu line. Once you know them you can scan and combine, and use them to infuse the xuanshu works and build the wands.

All things are made of aspects, and above the aspects stand the eight trigrams: Qian, Dui, Li, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Gen and Kun. Each is formed from two aspects you already know, so each is both a key to research and a stone set into a wand to steady infusion.

The pages that follow cover how to gain the trigrams, then the order of forging.
bagua.page.source_scan:
§l1. Scan what already exists (fastest)§r
Scan these with a Thaumometer:
Qian - Daylight Detector
Dui - Golden Apple
Li - Firework Rocket
Zhen - Bell
Xun - Note Block
Kan - Seagrass
Gen - Blast Furnace
Kun - Hay Bale
bagua.page.source_fuse:
§l2. Combine at the research table§r
Drag the two aspects that form a trigram into the rune circle and press the purple fuse button. You will learn that trigram and it is recorded in your aspect knowledge for good.

§l3. Boil out the essentia§r
Boil those same eight things in a crucible for the matching bagua essentia; the four beast ingots and the xuanshu works also carry trigram qi. Every drop of essentia the xuanshu works demand comes from here.
bagua.page.rule:
§lHow the trigrams are formed§r
Qian = Aer + Lux
Dui = Aqua + Metallum
Li = Ignis + Lux
Zhen = Aer + Tempestas
Xun = Aer + Arbor
Kan = Aqua + Tenebrae
Gen = Terra + Vinculum
Kun = Terra + Perditio

Aspect names are shown in Latin throughout the Thaumonomicon; go by the icon and the description.
bagua.page.terrain_all:
§lThe Earthly Qi of the Eight Trigrams§r
Each trigram gathers its qi in a certain kind of place. Wherever a place matches one, that qi gathers there - a spot may match only one, or none at all.
§fQian§0 open sky, nothing overhead
§3Dui§0 swamps (mangrove swamps included)
§4Li§0 the Nether's crimson and warped forests
§6Zhen§0 badlands (mesa)
bagua.page.ingot_a:
§lHow to lay out the four beast ingots§r
All four ingots are made in the §5Arcane Workbench§0, costing 100 of each primal aspect. Lay them out on a 3x3 grid:
§8Centre§0 Mystic Ingot
§8Four corners§0 one World Salt each (four in all)
§8Bottom middle§0 Diamond
bagua.page.assembly:
§lAssembling a wand§r
Lay them on one diagonal of the Arcane Workbench: the rod in the centre cell, and two identical caps at the top-right and bottom-left corners. That makes the wand.
A wand takes two caps of the same kind - the two ends of a wand are one thing.

§lVermilion Butterfly Grand Wrapped Wand§r 600 vis, 90% cost.
§lBagua Sixiang Obsidian Wand§r 1500 vis, 80% cost.
§lXuanshu Cosmic Silverwood Wrapped Wand§r 5200 vis, 60% cost.
bagua.page.materials_b:
§lXuanshu Curios§r
§lXuanshu Crystal§r - a bagua shard at the centre with one of each beast ingot, 4 xuanshu shards and 4 Salis Mundus; six of each trigram. Its block form joins the infusion stabiliser tag, so every symmetric pair around the matrix presses down one row of instability, and the block itself zeroes instability within twelve blocks.

§lAkashic Records§r - a bagua shard at the centre with eight Xuanshu Bagua Salt; twenty of each trigram.

The first steadies infusion; the second fills in your aspect knowledge.

§lQian (three yang)§r
Three yang lines, the image of Heaven. Strong, central and unyielding.One colour throughout: burnished gold.

bagua.gua.li.scan:

bagua.gua.zhen:

The image of Thunder. Arousing, stirring, the start of spring.One colour throughout: jade green.

bagua.gua.zhen.scan:

§lGains of Kan§r
Scan §5Seagrass§0 to learn this trigram.

Scan a §5Blast Furnace§0 to learn this trigram.

bagua.page.focus:
§lXuanshu Foci (infusion)§r
§lCosmos§r - Pearl centre, six shards around it, 128 of each trigram. On a wand, right-click a block and spend one of each primal aspect: the block drops as an item, even bedrock.
§lGuardian§r - Totem centre, 2 Quicksilver, 2 Glowstone Dust, 4 Salis Mundus, 4 enchanted fabric, 128 of each trigram. Right-click, spend 200 of each aspect: a heart circles you, takes one death, and breaks.
§lTeleport§r - Pearl centre, six shards around it, 128 of each trigram. Shift right-click binds your spot; right-click spends 10 of each aspect to return. A blocked landing searches upward.
bagua.page.caps:
§lAll Ways Return to the Pivot§r
The xuanshu works fall into three lines, listed in the order in which they are forged:
§lKan -> Xuanshu Ingot -> Xuanshu Shard§r, and shards become cloth, rods and caps.
§lXuanshu Ingot§r - arcane crafting and infusion, plus the four beast array.
§lXuanshu Shard§r - alchemy and the Infernal Furnace, five recipes each.
§lCloth / Rod / Cap§r - wrapping and assembly, three recipes each.
§lBagua Terrain§r - hung off Kun, records where each qi gathers.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:ING: Beast ingots and the Xuanshu Ingot
bagua.page.node_ingots:
§lXuanshu Ingot§r
The four beast ingots are made in the §5Arcane Workbench§0: Mystic Ingot in the centre, one World Salt in each corner, Diamond in the bottom middle, and one reagent for that beast in the top middle plus the two middle side cells.
The Xuanshu Ingot goes through §5infusion§0 instead, and is the cornerstone of the whole line.
The five pages after this are their recipes: four arcane grids, then one infusion, each with a note.
bagua.page.node_shards:
§lXuanshu Shards§r
Beast ingots into a crucible, two of each trigram, give that beast's shard; the Xuanshu Shard is made by alchemy. §5Only the Xuanshu Infernal Furnace smelts these§0: a beast ingot yields four bagua shards and a xuanshu shard yields two Xuanshu Bagua Salt - an ordinary furnace produces nothing, and everything that goes into the infernal furnace comes out doubled.

The spreads that follow are five alchemy recipes then five smelting recipes, each with its own note.
bagua.page.node_cloths:
§lXuanshu Cloth§r
Sixiang cloth is silver as the moon, xuanshu cloth black-gold within; both are woven by alchemy and both are the sacred stuff that wraps a wand rod.

The two spreads that follow are the two recipes - Sixiang first, Xuanshu second - each with its own note.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:WAN: Three rods and how to assemble them
bagua.page.node_wands:
§lXuanshu Wand Rods§r
The rod is the bone of a wand, and all three are made by infusion.
Afterwards lay the rod and two caps diagonally on an arcane workbench (rod in the centre, caps upper-right and lower-left) and the wand is assembled - so one wand needs two identical caps.

The three spreads that follow take Xuanshu, Sixiang and Vermilion in turn, each recipe beside its own note.
bagua.page.node_caps:
§lWand Caps§r
The cap is the understanding at the other end of the wand, and all three are made by infusion.

Since assembly puts the rod in the centre and two identical caps at upper-right and lower-left, every wand costs two caps. The three spreads that follow take Xuanshu, Sixiang and Vermilion in turn, each recipe beside its own note.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_infern: Three chambers smelt in parallel; one fuel feeds all three.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_pedest: The altar awakens: the four symbols take their places
The altar sleeps: the four symbols fade
The four corners lack Sixiang Stone Bricks
The altar is asleep and accepts nothing (right-click with a wand)
block.skydeitymysticpivot.bagua_stone.lo: Trigram stone. Wherever it stands, its qi attunes to the land of that chunk (%s is its nature).
bagua.page.stones_what:
§lTrigram Stones§r
Eight stones, one per trigram. They are not so much 'material' as 'position': wherever a stone stands, that is where its qi takes hold.

§8Gen§0 mountain, §1Kan§0 water, §2Xun§0 wind, §6Zhen§0 thunder
§4Li§0 fire, §3Dui§0 marsh, §fQian§0 sky, §eKun§0 earth

Know the trigram first; only then can you set it. The nature and the lands of each of the eight were written out a few pages back.
bagua.page.stones_recipe:
§lStones of the Eight§r
The page on the left cycles the eight crucible recipes: a stone brick in the pot and eight of the trigram's qi, out comes the stone.

Which stone you make depends only on which altar you mean to work at, and on what.
bagua.page.stones_use:
§lSetting the Gate§r
A few infusion recipes want trigram stones set first; without them the fire will not start. The recipe is not consumed: a puff of smoke, and the action bar names the missing trigram.

§8▍Which ring§r The §l5x5 single layer§r centred on the §lblock directly below the base§r - the ground layer only.

§8▍Extra stones press instability down§r Every stone beyond what the recipe asks for presses §b2§8 off instability, up to three stones counted (so at most -6).
bagua.page.stones:
§lTrigram Stones and the Xuanshu Pedestal§r
§lTrigram stones§r - eight stones, one per trigram: Li south, Kan north, Zhen east, Dui west, Qian north-west, Kun south-west, Xun south-east, Gen north-east. Made by alchemy: stone bricks into a crucible, eight of that trigram's qi.

§lXuanshu Pedestal§r - a black-and-gold seat. Set the four Sixiang Stone Bricks on its corners and strike it with a wand and it becomes an altar; only then does it read qi: stand it under the Qian qi (open sky) and obsidian on its face slowly turns to crying obsidian.
bagua.page.pedestal_altar:
§lXuanshu Pedestal: raising the altar§r
A pedestal on its own is not an altar, and reads no trigram qi. To wake it, set the four Sixiang stone bricks at the corners first:
1) Find flat ground and put one Xuanshu Pedestal in the middle.
2) Lay a 3x3 around it: one Sixiang stone brick in each of the §lfour corners§r, and leave the four cells touching the pedestal empty.
bagua.page.pedestal_qi:
§lOnce the Altar Is Raised§r
Only then does the pedestal count as standing here, and only then does it read the qi underfoot: the characters of that trigram float above its top and a ring of glyphs turns around it.

Only now is it worth putting anything on its face. Stand it under the Qian qi (open sky) and obsidian slowly turns to crying obsidian; anywhere else it will not.

A pedestal that has not been raised shows no trigram and accepts nothing - it is just a block. Break any one of the four bricks, or the pedestal itself, and the altar falls at once.
bagua.page.pedestal_lands:
§lWhere It Works§r
Each trigram gathers its qi in a certain kind of place, and that is what the pedestal reads:
§fQian§0 open sky, nothing overhead
§3Dui§0 swamps (mangrove swamps included)
§4Li§0 the Nether's crimson and warped forests
§6Zhen§0 badlands (mesa)
bagua.gua.qian.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Qian§r
Qian gathers in the §fopen sky§0 (Open Sky) - no block overhead.
Stand on a mountain top or open plain and look up.
bagua.gua.dui.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Dui§r
Dui gathers in the §3swamp§0 (Swamp, incl. mangrove).
Use /locate biome minecraft:swamp.
bagua.gua.li.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Li§r
Li gathers in the §4two nether forests§0: the Crimson Forest and the Warped Forest.
bagua.gua.zhen.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Zhen§r
Zhen gathers in the §6badlands§0 (Badlands).
Use /locate biome minecraft:badlands.
bagua.gua.xun.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Xun§r
Xun gathers in the §2forest§0 (Forest and all its kinds).
Use /locate biome minecraft:forest.
bagua.gua.kan.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Kan§r
Kan gathers in the §1warm ocean§0 (Warm Ocean).
Use /locate biome minecraft:warm_ocean.
bagua.gua.gen.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Gen§r
Gen gathers in the §8mountains§0 (Windswept Hills / Jagged Peaks and the like).
bagua.gua.kun.terrain:
§lEarthly Qi of Kun§r
Kun gathers §8deep underground§0 (Y<10, Deep Underground).
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_crucib: Three chambers brew at once, drawing essentia from jars and tubes within 5x5x5.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_alchem: Automated essentia smelting: feed it items and it burns out their essentia by itself, then ships it to the tubes and jars around it.
bagua.page.machine_furnace:
§lXuanshu Infernal Furnace§r
Three chambers run side by side and one piece of fuel drives all three; one batch per tick, up to 64 items per batch. Feed from the top, draw from the bottom, and each of the six faces can be configured (right-click empty-handed for the transfer panel).

§5Only this furnace smelts these§0: a beast ingot gives two bagua shards, a xuanshu shard gives two salt - an ordinary furnace gives nothing.
bagua.page.machine_crucible:
§lXuanshu Crucible§r
A single-block reworking of the crucible: no heat source, no water, and no flux to build up. Three work spaces boil three recipes at once, one batch per tick and up to 64 items a batch; drop in a catalyst and it starts.

Essentia is drawn from tubes and jars within 5x5x5 - it is itself an endpoint with suction 128, so tubes touching it push essentia in of their own accord.
bagua.page.machine_alchemy:
§lXuanshu Alchemy Furnace§r
The mirror of the crucible: it burns items into raw essentia. Three chambers, one batch per tick and up to 64 items a batch; the essentia is sent out to tubes and jars within 5x5x3. Right-click empty-handed for the transfer panel; each face can be Off or Auto-Input.

The crucible drinks essentia and makes items; this machine burns items and makes essentia - put the two together with a length of tubing between them and you have a production line.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:MAC: Three chambers, no fire, no water
Items into qi, out to the tubes
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:PED: Corners set, and the altar is raised
bagua.page.trigram_gate:
§lThe Gate§r
Some infusion recipes will not start until the named trigram stones stand below the base: without them the recipe is not consumed, only a puff of smoke, and the action bar names what is missing. They are read from the §l5x5 single layer§r centred on the §lblock directly below the base§r.

Which recipe wants which is written on its own recipe page; the §b§lTrigram Stones§r§0 entry covers how the stones are made and set.

Each extra stone presses §b2§8 off instability, up to three.
bagua.page.node_shards2:
§lWhy a shard is a shard§r
A beast ingot scatters into trigram qi in the crucible and gathers again as it cools, only it never gathers back into an ingot. What comes back is too small to hold a whole beast, and so it is called a shard.

The Xuanshu Shard is born of no beast; it is what a bagua shard becomes when boiled a second time, which is why it stands one rank - and one price - above the Sixiang works.
bagua.page.node_cloths2:
§lWoven, in a manner of speaking§r
Cloth here is not spun but boiled: throw the stuff into a crucible and the trigram qi weaves itself into warp and weft. The qi of the boiling stays in the cloth, which is why sixiang cloth feels cool and xuanshu cloth warm, and your hand can tell them apart.
bagua.page.node_wands2:
§lWhat makes a rod dear§r
Of the three, the Xuanshu rod is hardest: a Dragon Egg, a Nether Star, xuanshu ingots and shards, and its infusion demands all eight trigram stones at the base foot. The Sixiang rod follows, needing Gen, Li, Xun and Kun at the foot. The Vermilion rod is easiest of all - only gold and blaze powder, with Li and Gen at the foot.
bagua.page.node_caps2:
§lThe Three Pairs of Caps§r
The Xuanshu Cosmos Cap is hardest: it also needs xuanshu ingots and shards, and all eight trigrams at the infusion. The Sixiang Qilin Cap needs only bagua shards and beast ingots, with Gen, Li, Xun and Kun; the Vermilion Dance Cap is easiest, a fire shard at the centre with Li and Gen.

The cap governs how much Vis is spent, the rod how much is stored.
bagua.page.machine_furnace2:
§lOrigin§r
A single-block reworking of the Infernal Furnace: the great tower is gone, only the fiercest fire remains. The walls are nether brick and the flame shows through, so from a distance it looks like a coal left in the embers.

All three chambers share one mouth - which is why a single piece of fuel drives three at once, and why it is such a bargain.
bagua.page.machine_crucible2:
§lOrigin§r
The old crucible needed fire, water, and someone to watch the flux. This one needs none of it: the catalyst is the invitation, and the essentia comes calling.

The rim is a machined collar with a lens set in the front, so you can see what is inside.
bagua.page.machine_alchemy2:
§lOrigin§r
The eldest of the three xuanshu machines. It needs fire, so it shares the furnace's body; what it produces is not goods but breath, so it has no output face.

Whatever essentia it burns must be met by someone - and if no one comes, it goes looking for the nearest tube itself.
bagua.recipe.azure_dragon_ingot:
§lAzure Dragon Ingot§r - crafted at an §5arcane workbench§0: Salis Mundus in the four corners, a Thaumium Ingot at the centre, a diamond below, an Ender Crystal above and Dragon's Breath on the flanks; 100 of each primal aspect.

The Azure Dragon is wood, lord of the east. An ender crystal speaks to the void and dragon's breath is what a living mouth breathes out - the nature of wood is to live and never stop. The ingot is green as the first shoot of spring.
bagua.recipe.vermilion_bird_ingot:
§lVermilion Bird Ingot§r - crafted at an §5arcane workbench§0: Blaze Powder above and Glowstone Dust on the flanks, the rest as above.

The Vermilion Bird is fire, lord of the south. Blaze powder is the fiercest thing in fire, glowstone dust the brightest - put them together and the ingot burns vermilion.
bagua.recipe.white_tiger_ingot:
§lWhite Tiger Ingot§r - crafted at an §5arcane workbench§0: Calcite above and Quicksilver on the flanks, the rest as above.

The White Tiger is metal, lord of the west. Calcite is keen, quicksilver flows without sticking - the nature of metal is to cut. So the ingot is white throughout and rings when struck.
bagua.recipe.black_tortoise_ingot:
§lBlack Tortoise Ingot§r - crafted at an §5arcane workbench§0: Turtle Scute above and Prismarine Shards on the flanks, the rest as above.

The Black Tortoise is water, lord of the north. A scute is the hardest shell, prismarine the coldest stone - the nature of water is to sink and to keep. Of the four beasts it alone wins nothing by sharpness.
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_ingot:
§lXuanshu Ingot§r infusion
§8Centre§r bagua shard §8Pedestals§r 2 of each beast ingot, 4 Xuanshu Bagua Salt
§8Aspects§r 10 of each of the eight §8Instability§r §c5§r
§8▍Gate§r §8none (this one is unconstrained)§r

The qi of the four beasts meet here, blue and red and white and black mixed into one: xuan is black shot with red - the look of colours not yet separated.
bagua.recipe.azure_dragon_shard:
§lAzure Dragon Shard§r - alchemy: an Azure Dragon Ingot into a crucible, two of each trigram, and out comes the beast's shard.

The ingot scatters into qi and gathers again as it cools - too small to hold a whole beast, and so it must be called a shard.
bagua.recipe.vermilion_bird_shard:
§lVermilion Bird Shard§r - alchemy: a Vermilion Bird Ingot into a crucible, two of each trigram.

It is the hottest of the four: straight out of the crucible you can barely hold it, and it is only safe once cool.
bagua.recipe.white_tiger_shard:
§lWhite Tiger Shard§r - alchemy: a White Tiger Ingot into a crucible, two of each trigram.

The keenest of the four, its edge thin almost to invisibility - keep it apart in your pack or it will score the others.
bagua.recipe.black_tortoise_shard:
§lBlack Tortoise Shard§r - alchemy: a Black Tortoise Ingot into a crucible, two of each trigram.

The heaviest and calmest of the four: cool in the hand and it will not warm even over a fire.
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_shard:
§lXuanshu Shard§r - alchemy: a bagua shard into a crucible, four of each trigram.

Born of no beast, it is a bagua shard boiled a second time, and so it stands a rank above the Sixiang works - purple shot through with white, like a piece of star made solid.
bagua.recipe.azure_dragon_ingot_to_bagua:
§lAzure Dragon Ingot -> Bagua Shard§r - §5Xuanshu Infernal Furnace only§0: one ingot in, two bagua shards out; an ordinary furnace gives nothing.

A beast is only the eight trigrams wearing a shape. Take the shape apart and the eight remain.
bagua.recipe.vermilion_bird_ingot_to_bag:
§lVermilion Bird Ingot -> Bagua Shard§r - §5Xuanshu Infernal Furnace only§0: one ingot in, two shards out, exactly double.

Every beast ingot yields the same shards and none can be told from another - by this point the four beasts have gone back to being eight trigrams.
bagua.recipe.white_tiger_ingot_to_bagua_:
§lWhite Tiger Ingot -> Bagua Shard§r - §5Xuanshu Infernal Furnace only§0: one ingot in, two shards out.

The fire inside is the one from the Infernal Furnace; an ordinary furnace never reaches that heat and can never take a beast apart.
bagua.recipe.black_tortoise_ingot_to_bag:
§lBlack Tortoise Ingot -> Bagua Shard§r - §5Xuanshu Infernal Furnace only§0: one ingot in, two shards out.

The tortoise endures the fire longest and sits in the furnace longer than the rest - but the yield is the same: two.
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_bagua_salt:
§lXuanshu Shard -> Xuanshu Bagua Salt§r - §5Xuanshu Infernal Furnace only§0: one shard in, two salt out, again doubled.

Salt is the root of everything: without it the beast ingots will not settle and no wand can be wrapped.
bagua.recipe.sixiang_cloth:
§lSixiang Cloth§r - alchemy: white wool into a crucible, two of each trigram.

Silver as the moon, the thinnest of the Sixiang works - the sky must exist before anything can be written on it. When you wrap a rod, this is the layer that shows.
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_cloth:

Cloth woven from salt is itself a ward: black-gold within, it holds the Vis in and lets none leak. It goes inside the sixiang cloth.

block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_purify: Once placed, it purges its own chunk every two seconds: tainted blocks and tainted biomes, nearby Flux Goo and Gas, and every point of Warp and corruption effect on players inside.
message.skydeitymysticpivot.purifying_st: The Xuanshu Purifying Stone is set; the corruption here is receding.
bagua.page.pickaxe_intro:
§lXuanshu Pickaxe§r
A thaumium pickaxe infused with trigram qi. §lQian§r is sky and unyielding, and of the trigrams it is the one that answers to metal: metal and stone are its charge, so with this pick, even a mountain gives way.

It is the cheapest of the xuanshu works: bagua shards and thaumium ingots on the pedestals, no xuanshu ingot at all.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:XUA: An infused tool: a thaumium pickaxe at the centre with 4 bagua shards and 2 thaumium ingots on the pedestals; 48 each of terra and ordo, 32 each of the rest, instability 4. Set one Qian stone below the base.
bagua.page.stones_place:
§lHow to place them§r
Lay a single 5x5 layer of trigram stones centred on the cell directly under the pedestal; only the ground layer counts. The same goes when the Xuanshu Pedestal is the base.
How many and which trigrams is written on that recipe's own page. One stone short and nothing starts: nothing is consumed, you just get a puff of smoke and the action bar names the missing trigram.
§8▍ Stones are not consumed§r Dig them up and set them elsewhere.
§8▍ Extra stones quell instability: each extra shaves 2 off, up to three.§r
bagua.page.pickaxe_qian:
§lWhy Qian§r
The Shuo Gua says 'Qian is metal': a pick is a thing of metal and stone, so this infusion sets a Qian stone and nothing else.

§8▍Set one block anywhere inside the 5x5 single layer centred on the block below the base; one is enough.§r
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:PUR: Stand it in tainted land and the land turns green again.
bagua.page.purify_intro:
§lXuanshu Purifying Stone§r
Stand it in tainted land and it washes the area back, a sweep every two seconds: tainted blocks return to dirt and grass, tainted and eerie biomes revert, nearby flux goo is eaten; players standing in the area have permanent and sticky warp cleared and the lingering corruptions pulled off them.

Standing alone it only covers the chunk it sits in.
bagua.page.purify_array:
§lThe Eightfold Array§r
Standing alone, the Purifying Stone washes only its own chunk. To widen its reach, ring it with a 3x3 array.

§l1. Parts§r
- Centre cell: one §8Xuanshu Purifying Stone§0 (infusion recipe later in this entry).
- The eight cells around it: one §8trigram stone§0 each, one of every trigram (crucible recipes in the Trigram Stones entry).
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_purifying_stone:
§lXuanshu Purifying Stone§r infusion
§8Centre§r flux scrubber §8Pedestals§r 3 Xuanshu Ingots, 2 Bagua Shards, 2 Ethereal Blooms, 2 Xuanshu Bagua Salt
§8Aspects§r 32 of each of the six §8Instability§r §c6§r

The scrubber folded into a single stone - except it does not wipe one spot at a time, it washes a whole stretch of land back.
message.skydeitymysticpivot.purifying_st: The Eightfold Array is raised: the range grows to the nine chunks centred here.
The Eightfold Array is lowered: the range falls back to this one chunk.
The eight directions are not filled yet: each of the eight outer cells around the stone needs one trigram stone, one of each kind.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_purify: Ring it 3x3 with one of each of the eight trigram stones, then right-click the centre with a wand: all nine take altar shape at once, and the range grows to the nine chunks around it.
message.skydeitymysticpivot.teleport.non: This wand has no bound point yet: shift right-click to bind one
message.skydeitymysticpivot.teleport.no_: Not enough vis: teleporting costs %s of each primal
message.skydeitymysticpivot.teleport.dim: The bound dimension no longer exists
message.skydeitymysticpivot.teleport.blo: Landing spot is blocked and no free space was found
bagua.page.purify_array2:
§l2. Layout§r
All nine cells sit on the same ground layer.
- The centre cell takes the Purifying Stone.
- The eight cells touching it take one trigram stone each.
- All eight trigrams must be present; which cell gets which does not matter.
bagua.page.purify_array3:
§l3. Raising it§r
A finished array does not start on its own - §8it is off by default§0. §8Right-click the centre stone with a wand§0 to raise it: all nine stones take altar shape at once. Right-click again to lower it; dig away any one ring stone and the array drops on its own.

§lOnce raised§r
The range grows from this one chunk to the nine chunks centred here.
Trigram stones can be dug back up and re-set elsewhere - they are not consumed.
